summary_md: **Dra ([@bydradev](https://x.com/bydradev/status/2116002289613992233))** argues a vendor install command isn't a review, noting Cloudflare's and Neon's agent skills needed 12 fixes in one app, and shares the **verify-external-claims** skill in gh-repo-bootstrapper that pins a reviewed commit and keeps fixes out of vendor files ([SKILL.md](https://github.com/bydradev/gh-repo-bootstrapper/blob/main/templates/skills/verify-external-claims/SKILL.md#third-party-)).
